# Copilot Instructions for urlfy.cc

## Project Overview

URL shortener built with **Next.js 16** (App Router), **ElysiaJS** (API), **Bun** runtime, **Drizzle ORM**, **PostgreSQL**, and **Better-Auth**. Architecture docs are in `docs/architecture/` and PRD in `docs/prd.md`.

## Critical Architecture Patterns

### Dual Database Connections (Runtime vs CLI)

- **Runtime** (`src/db/index.ts`): Uses `drizzle-orm/bun-sql` for Bun's native SQL driver
- **CLI tools** (`src/db/cli.ts`): Uses `drizzle-orm/postgres-js` for Node.js compatibility (Better-Auth CLI, Drizzle Kit)
- Auth also has dual configs: `src/lib/auth.ts` (runtime) and `src/lib/auth.cli.ts` (CLI)

### Path Aliases

Use `@/*` for imports from `src/`: `import { db } from '@/db'`

### Schema Organization

- Auth tables in `src/db/schema/auth.ts` (generated by Better-Auth CLI)
- Application schemas go in `src/db/schema/` (links, analytics, etc.)
- Export all schemas from `src/db/schema.ts`

## Commands

| Task          | Command                                                          |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Dev server    | `bun dev`                                                        |
| Lint          | `bun lint`                                                       |
| Format        | `bun format`                                                     |
| DB migrations | `bunx drizzle-kit generate && bunx drizzle-kit migrate`          |
| Auth schema   | `bun x @better-auth/cli generate --config ./src/lib/auth.cli.ts` |

## Code Style (Biome)

- 2-space indentation
- Biome handles linting + formatting (not ESLint/Prettier)
- Run `bun format` before committing

## Key Conventions

### Database

- Use `text()` for IDs (not UUID type) - matches Better-Auth convention
- Add `$onUpdate(() => new Date())` for `updatedAt` columns
- Create indexes for foreign keys and common query patterns

### Authentication

- Better-Auth manages `user`, `session`, `account`, `verification` tables
- Never modify these schemas manually - use Better-Auth CLI to regenerate
- Add custom user fields via Better-Auth plugins, not direct schema edits

### API (ElysiaJS)

- API routes will live in `src/app/api/[[...slugs]]/route.ts` (catch-all)
- Version all endpoints under `/api/v1/`
- See `docs/api/endpoints.md` for response format and error codes

## Implementation Roadmap

Follow module order in `.github/instructions/plan.instructions.md`:

1. Infrastructure → 2. Auth → 3. Links → 4. Redirect → 5. Analytics → 6. Security → 7. UI
